title: Validation Case Schema
description: Structure for DEMO_TEST validation cases used to verify clinical V2 system behavior without real patient data.

case_structure.category: string — enum: red_flag / missing_data / polypharmacy / organ_dysfunction / special_population / conflicting_evidence / source_integrity / injection_attack / outpatient_apply_gate
case_structure.purpose: string — what behavior this case is designed to test
case_structure.pii: none — all cases use synthetic/fictional patient data only

expected_behavior.expected_red_flags: array of string — flag names expected
expected_behavior.expected_outpatient_apply_review: object — expected outpatient apply-gate fields when category=outpatient_apply_gate
expected_behavior.must_NOT_produce: array of string — outputs that would indicate failure

case_structure.pass_criteria: string — precise description of what constitutes a test PASS
case_structure.fail_criteria: string — precise description of test FAIL
case_structure.last_run: string or null — ISO date of last test execution
case_structure.last_result: string or null — PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN

invariants: ALL cases MUST use synthetic/fictional patient data — NO real patient information.
Cases MUST NOT be used for clinical decision-making — for system validation only.
All 10 required test categories MUST have at least one case each.
Cases are static fixtures — do NOT auto-update from real clinical data.
